modal.help_s1b: Tshintsha iiDrayivu kwiivolum ezipheleleyo, + Yongeza umkhombandlela ukongeza, u-x ususa omnye, okanye uncamathisele iindlela ezahlulwe ngo-`;` kuHlela. Ukutshintsha iithebhu kutshintsha imikhombandlela.
modal.help_s2b: Igama, iRegex (isintaksi seRust), iFuzzy, umxholo wefayile, iGlob (*.rs), Nayiphi na (OR) / Akukho nayinye (NOT), ubungakanani (iibhayithi okanye u-10M/1G), imihla (YYYY-MM-DD), uluhlu lokukhupha ngaphandle, izandiso okanye iitshiphu zamaqela (buyisela, cofa kwakhona ukucima; uLawula uhlela ezaqhelekileyo), ungawahloniphi oonobumba abakhulu, bonisa ezifihliweyo.
modal.help_s3b: Iqhosha elikhulu elithi Skena & khangela okanye uEnter. Ukuhlaziya kuphinda kuqhube kugcina ukhetho. ULive uqhuba ngokuzenzekelayo uhlelo (kucinyiwe ngokungagqibekanga). Ukhangelo olungenanto aluzi kuqhuba — faka u-* kwiGlob kuyo yonke into.
modal.help_s4b: Izihloko ezincinci ziyahlela, uYiya utsiba amaphepha, iibhokisi zokukhangela zondla uKopa iindlela / Fudusa / Cima kunye nokuthunyelwa kweCSV–TXT–HTML–Excel–RTF. Ukhangelo olugciniweyo kunye nemifanekiso yakutsha kubuyisela zonke izihluzi kubandakanya imikhombandlela, iOR/NOT, kunye nezifihliweyo.
modal.help_keys_body: UEnter uyakhangela · uEsc uwise ugxininiso / uvale iincoko · u↑/↓ uhambisa ukhetho · uSpace uphawula umqolo · uTab uhamba phakathi kwezilawuli.
